title: Why gravitational instantons arise from monopoles
exact_target: Understand moduli-space origins and constructions of gravitational instantons, their asymptotic symmetries, and distinctions among Ricci-flat and self-dual geometries.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002522 (AIM-PHYSICS-0030). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

American Institute of Mathematics, $L^2$ harmonic forms in geometry and string theory; notes by Anda Degeratu and Mark Haskins, March 2004, 17 March 2004, Self-dual Gravitational Instantons questions.

status_qualification: The workshop contains physical intuition and partial answers alongside questions. They are source context, not independent proofs checked here. Well-behaved asymptotics and the higher-dimensional replacement for self-duality require precise specification; the original informal breadth is preserved. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
